dimension: dense legend with forty-plus classes across ten atlas pages
expected: legend splits across pages or uses an approved continuation while class order, units and totals stay identical; no class is dropped

dimension: long Chinese and mixed-language title reflow between portrait and landscape
expected: title reflows or wraps within the page and never truncates or falls below the frozen font floor

dimension: extreme-shape slivers and duplicate parcels in an overlay conflict run
expected: sliver and duplicate partitions stay exclusive and every count recomputes; an undeclared tolerance blocks instead of guessing

dimension: font substitution pressure on a saved project style
expected: the recorded fallback is applied from the saved style, family and version are recorded, and no token value drifts

dimension: one-hundred-page batch run with a cancellation request mid-series
expected: cancellation stops the job cleanly, completed pages keep their receipts and the cancelled remainder is disclosed rather than reported as success

dimension: external master modified by the user while a job is running
expected: the original hash is unchanged, a new revision is generated, and any merge scope that cannot be verified is refused

dimension: same-source numbers diverge after a data refresh between map and report
expected: the mismatch is detected before delivery and the stale revision is refused; no number is silently rounded to match

dimension: broken dependency inside a handover package
expected: the broken edge is counted and named, includeBroken=false does not hide it, and the package fails acceptance

dimension: raster pair misaligned by half a cell
expected: the offset is quantified in units and pixels and the transition matrix is withheld until alignment resolves; no silent resample

dimension: CRS pair with no host-published transformation candidate
expected: the empty candidate list is returned with a reason and any downstream reprojection is blocked

dimension: ten-thousand-row constraint violation flood with mixed domain types
expected: violation identities and per-constraint counts recompute exactly and an unparseable constraint reports UNKNOWN rather than satisfied

dimension: duplicate geometry flood combined with attribute-only duplicates
expected: group partition arithmetic holds in every mode and no row appears in two groups of the same mode

dimension: reportPath pointed at an existing artifact, then at a C-drive path
expected: the existing target is refused through the pre-existing OUTPUT_EXISTS gate, an off-D path is refused, and read-only mode refuses reportPath

dimension: twelve-class confusion matrix with zero-count cells and long labels
expected: zero cells stay visible, totals recompute, and no class is merged to improve the layout

dimension: error band reflowed into a 16:9 deck without losing interval semantics
expected: method, units and interval meaning survive the reflow; the expression may not be simplified into an unsupported confidence claim

dimension: schema drift between two vintages that breaks the declared key fields
expected: the schema difference is reported as its own class and the comparison is blocked rather than matched by position
